parsed.explanation: No traveler-facing restriction, targeting, border, facility, custody, or care denial is documented, and same-sex consensual activity is legal with no trans-specific offence. Resident-facing self-ID, anti-discrimination and healthcare measures count only as a strong institutional-climate signal, not direct visitor protection. Social acceptance is supported by anti-discrimination law, an openly gay head of government, organised advocacy, and removal/apology for a transphobic article. Offset by thin traveler-specific evidence: no documented operating visitor remedy, incomplete bias-crime enforcement and no hate-crime classification system, and reported microaggressions rarely reported from fear. The 2-3 monthly bias incidents are a raw, all-motive count without denominator, so carry no magnitude. Overall reduced risk, below jurisdictions documenting both acceptance and working visitor protections.
